integrity: The proof classifies all oriented partitions through a bounded signed-digit equation; an independent finite checker is included for small instances. No independent external audit has been performed.
limitations: The exact multiplicity formula is proved only for 2^a < p <= 2^(a+1)-1 with b odd. The lower half p <= 2^a can have additional partitions. Literature searches cannot exclude every obscure equivalent formulation.
title: Exact Zumkeller partition multiplicity in the upper two-prime strip
